stem:
Diya records that two classmates each read about $20$ pages on a school night. She wants a claim about reading for all children in the city.

Which claim is warranted?

options.text: Two classmates are enough for a citywide claim once the page counts are written down.
Citywide reading is what produces the two classmates' page counts, so the city average must be $20$.
The two classmates give a local note, but not a citywide reading claim.
Any pair of page counts may be used as a city estimate for every school subject, not only reading.

teacher.key_rationale: Two local cases do not warrant a citywide claim. Treating any written sample as enough omits sample limits. Saying the city produces the two readings reverses evidence direction. Extending to every subject overscopes the reading note.
